note: The corpus's plain user-defined Verilog task: classic non-ANSI declaration, input and output arguments, one call from a clocked process. Covers hif-backend#38 (a task was not emitted as a task), #64 (its out arguments were not declared) and #70 (an out argument assigned with `<=`, so the copy-back on return published the previous call's value). Behavioral because #70's output is valid Verilog that is merely one call behind. Distinct from verilog_task_arguments, which is the ANSI header with an inout argument and is expected to fail on hif-frontend#31; nothing here mixes a direct assignment with a task-call write, so this design exercises the task path on its own.
